## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:在移动端外壳(ObjectStack mobile)里,文件/图片字段多了「拍照 / 从相册选择」(走外壳的 `pickImage()`),记录附件点开时由 Console 用自己的会话取回文件字节交给外壳的 `openFile()` 预览,记录页「分享」走外壳的 `share()` 调起系统分享面板。普通浏览器和旧版外壳行为完全不变。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁决(mobile#147 选项 A)要求 Console 自己取文件、外壳不碰会话;外壳侧 mobile#180 已提供这三个方法,Console 若不调用就是「已声明却无人使用」的能力。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。三处都先做能力探测(`has()`),不满足就走原来的路径;拍到的照片走字段原有的上传管线(同样的大小校验、同样存 `sys_file` 引用)。附件超过 8 MiB、取字节失败或外壳拒收(`bad_args`)都回到原来的打开方式。签名下载链接是凭证,从不交给外壳。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` 的 `openInNativeShell`(取字节、8 MiB 判断、回退);② `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx` / `ImageField.tsx` 里照片如何进入原上传管线;③ `ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts` 新增的可选成员与包装函数(公开面扩展,需契约复核)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeImagePick.shellPhoto.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx`,预期 4 个文件全绿(135 个用例)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(`@object-ui/mobile` 公开面扩展的契约复核由席位转总监)。

## What changes

The ObjectStack mobile shell offers three optional bridge methods for files (objectstack-ai/mobile `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md`, "Files", shell side mobile#180), each feature-detected with `has()`. The Console now calls them. A plain browser and an older shell take exactly today's path.

1. **Bridge (`@object-ui/mobile`, `nativeHost.ts`).** `ObjectStackNative` gains optional `pickImage?`, `openFile?` and `share?` (an older shell lacks them), the method union gains the three names, and the typed wrappers `nativePickImage`, `nativeOpenFile`, `nativeShare` follow the `scan` / `showConnectionSwitcher` precedent (feature-detect through `nativeHostCan`, then `host.x!()`; resolve `unavailable | ok | failed`, never throw). New types `NativePickImageOptions`, `NativeFile`, `NativeShareContent`; the bridge limit `NATIVE_FILE_MAX_BYTES` (8 MiB, the shell's `MAX_FILE_BYTES`); helpers `fileFromNativeFile` (bridge file to an uploadable `File`) and `nativeFileFromBlob` (bytes to padded base64 with no `data:` prefix and a parameter-free MIME type). All exported from the package entry: a public widening, so a contract review is owed.
2. **pickImage (`@object-ui/fields`).** In a shell announcing `pickImage`, `FileField` (when the field accepts images) routes its existing camera button through `pickImage({ camera: true })` and adds "Choose photo" (`pickImage({ camera: false })`); `capture: false` still hides the camera. `ImageField` adds "Take photo" and "Choose photo" under its upload button. The picked image becomes a `File` and enters the SAME pipeline an input pick does: `FileField`'s `processFiles`, and `ImageField`'s input handler body lifted into `uploadPicked`, which both the input and the shell call. No second upload route. Cancel (`null`) uploads nothing; a shell failure shows the error toast with the shell's message (`fields.file.photoFailed`). Internal helper `widgets/nativeImagePick.ts`, not exported. The grid `FileCell` and `AvatarField` are not touched.
3. **openFile (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel`).** The row's Download tap still fetches the signed URL with the Console's own session. In a shell announcing `openFile`, it then fetches the bytes and hands only the bytes to `openFile`. A row over 8 MiB (judged before any byte is fetched, and again on the fetched size), a failed byte fetch (for example a cross-origin storage URL without CORS), or any non-`ok` answer (`bad_args` included) keeps today's `window.open`.
4. **share (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `RecordDetailView` `sys_share`).** In a shell announcing `share`, the record header's Share calls `share({ url: location.href, text: document.title })`. A refusal or failure falls back to today's `navigator.share` or clipboard copy. Only the record URL crosses the bridge.
5. **i18n.** `fields.file.choosePhoto` and `fields.file.photoFailed` in the ten locale packs.
6. **Docs.** `ui/packages/mobile/README.md`: the typed-wrapper line names the three new wrappers, and one entry names `NATIVE_FILE_MAX_BYTES` and the two file helpers (added to the amended file list on the seat's word: doc follows export).

## Tests

- `packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx`: the fake bridge carries the three methods; each wrapper resolves `unavailable` with no bridge, when `has()` says no, and when the method is missing; `pickImage` forwards options and resolves the file or `null`; `openFile` forwards the file and resolves `failed` / `bad_args` on refusal; `share` forwards url and text; the 8 MiB constant; base64 decode and encode helpers.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeImagePick.shellPhoto.test.tsx` (new, 12 tests): buttons only when `has('pickImage')`; camera and library both upload the picked `File` (name, type, size checked) through the field's `UploadProvider` adapter and `onChange` gets the `sys_file` id; cancel uploads nothing; failure toasts and uploads nothing; `capture: false`; a non-image `accept`; the picked image meets the same `maxSize` check. CONTROL: no shell and an older shell draw no shell button.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (6 tests): `openFile` gets exactly `{ base64, name, mime }`, the signed-URL token appears in no shell call, `openExternal` / `share` untouched, no tab; over 8 MiB by row size (no byte fetch) and by fetched size; `bad_args`; failed byte fetch; CONTROL older shell. The plain-browser control is the existing signed-URL download describe, unchanged and green.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (4 tests): Share calls `share` with exactly the record URL and title and copies nothing; refusal falls back to the clipboard; CONTROL older shell and plain browser copy as today.
- Ablation per leg, each restored to HEAD by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): bridge `share` forwards `{}` (1 red); `FileField` drops the picked files (2 red); `ImageField` drops the picked files (2 red); the panel skips `openInNativeShell` (2 red); Share ignores the shell's `ok` (1 red).

## Acceptance notes

- Attachment share is not added (seat ruling A in 6595245493): no attachment share action exists, the contract's Console list names only "sharing a record link", the stable `/storage/files/:id` link needs the Console's Bearer session (dead for a recipient), and the signed URL is a credential.
- `plugin-detail`'s `DetailView` has its own `sys_share`; it is not on the Console record page and is unchanged.
- The file-field download links (`FileValueAffordance`), the grid `FileCell` and `AvatarField` keep today's behaviour; the contract names attachments and image/attachment fields.
- `openFile` passes the row's file name as is; a name the shell refuses (`bad_args`) takes the browser path.
- No real shell in the container: every leg is driven through the shell fake.
